summary: סְדֹם names the city of Sodom. Genesis uses it to describe the course of the Canaanite boundary.

senses.definition: The city of Sodom, named with Gomorrah in the description of Canaanite territory.

evidence.note: בֹּאֲכָה סְדֹמָה means “as you go toward Sodom” and gives the direction of the boundary.
